verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck a minion gap where her E lands the stun; you win if you hold E for her commit and force all-ins while her W is down.

brief.thesis: Darius has no real gap-closer outside E (Apprehend, range 535) and his Q (Decimate) is point-blank range 1, while Irelia carries two tools that let her pick the fight — Q (Bladesurge) dashes and resets off a Marked target or kill, and E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anyone caught between the converging blades. The measured 49.7% win rate over 2392 games and EVEN solo-kill rate reflect that she dictates range more often than you do, but neither side has a clean execute edge before level 6.

theirWindow.what: Flawless Duet's stun and Mark lets her free-cast Bladesurge off you for a reset; don't stand in the gap between her blades past level 3, and back off cautiously instead of fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Defiant Dance) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Defiant Dance reduces the physical damage she takes while charging, so it blanks your all-in if it's up. When it's down (20/18/16/14/12s cooldown), E-pull and dump Q, W, and R without eating a discount.

powerCurve.note: Her E stun chains Q resets
R enables true-damage execute at 5 stacks
Core items trade evenly, stacks decide
Max-stack enrage outscales her duelist kit

start.why: Run by 84.4% of Darius players at a 49.9% win rate over 2468 games — the AD applies Hemorrhage stacks faster and the sustain covers Bladesurge poke.

boots.why: 86% pick rate at 50% win rate — cuts the physical damage from her auto-reset dashes and Ionian Fervor-stacked attacks.

core.why: Part of the top core path (59% win rate, 217 games); the active gives you the burst of speed to close on a kiting Bladesurge target.
Move speed buildup counters her dash-based disengage so you aren't chasing a reset forever.
Converts her burst into a damage-over-time tick you can out-sustain while your Hemorrhage stacks build back up.

situational.when: you're ahead and need to survive a counter-engage after your all-in
her on-hit Ionian Fervor stacks are draining your hp in extended trades
you need the slow to stick through her repeated Bladesurge dashes

runes.keystoneWhy: Run at 49.1% win rate (23.4% pick); the stacking adaptive damage and healing rewards exactly the kind of extended, bleed-stacking trade Hemorrhage sets up. Master-tier Darius players instead favor Stormraider's Surge (17,974 games) for a burst-reset all-in style — better suited if you plan to force E-into-R kills rather than grind stacks.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite posts the best measured win rate (51.7% over 28.7% pick) of the three common pages. With solo-kill odds EVEN, Ignite's burn denies the sustain she gets off Bladesurge's heal in all-ins.

playing.title: Land E before she resets Q
playing.detail: Apprehend's hook (range 535) pulls her to melee before she can dash off a low-HP minion or a Marked target; throw it the instant she commits, not as a kill-secure afterthought.

playing.title: Trade only when her W is down
playing.detail: Defiant Dance shields her from physical damage while charging. Check the 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown before committing your full combo, or you're hitting a discount.

playing.title: Respect her E stun window
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks anyone caught between the two converging blades, feeding a free Bladesurge reset. Don't stand in that gap at level 3+.

playing.title: Stack Hemorrhage before all-in
playing.detail: Build Hemorrhage to 5 stacks with Q and autos first; Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales directly with stacks, turning R from poke into a kill threat from level 6.

playing.title: Punish her Q on minions
playing.detail: She can Bladesurge off a low-HP minion to reposition for free. If she does this away from her wave, your E still has the range to catch her before the reset lands.

playing.title: Use Ignite to deny her sustain
playing.detail: Bladesurge heals her on hit, and lane trades keep her topped up. Ignite's burn removes that cushion in the EVEN-odds all-ins this matchup produces.

playing.title: Build into Dead Man's Plate for stick
playing.detail: Her whole kit is dash-reliant disengage. The move speed buildup after Youmuu's closes distance she tries to create with repeated Bladesurge resets.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reading of timings and trade windows is our own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] to pull Irelia while keeping in mind that she can use (Q) on minions to move around. Try to use your abilities when her (W) is on cooldown.
